headline: Russian strike on buses in Ukraine's Kramatorsk kills at least 33
headline_es: Ataque ruso contra autobuses en Kramatorsk, Ucrania, deja al menos 33 muertos
caption_es: Un ataque ruso alcanzó el jueves dos autobuses urbanos en una parada de Kramatorsk, en el este de Ucrania y cerca del frente, y dejó al menos 33 muertos y 18 heridos, según las autoridades locales. La policía indicó que se usó una bomba planeadora. El concejo municipal lo calificó de crimen contra civiles; Rusia niega atacar a civiles.
caption_en: A Russian strike hit two city buses at a bus stop in Kramatorsk, in eastern Ukraine near the front line, on Thursday, killing at least 33 people and wounding 18, local authorities said. Police said a glide bomb was used. The city council called it a crime against civilians; Russia denies targeting civilians.
summary_es: Una bomba planeadora rusa alcanzó dos autobuses urbanos en una parada cerca del frente. Hay al menos 33 muertos y 18 heridos, según las autoridades.
summary_en: A Russian glide bomb hit two city buses at a stop near the front line. At least 33 people were killed and 18 wounded, authorities said.
